props.description:
The chrome around the content: a `window` with a title bar, a `schematic` window (a striped title bar on the
blueprint frame radius), a `phone`, or a `plain` border. Defaults to `window`.
props.name: variant

props.description: The window's title, address or file name, shown in its title bar; only `window` and `schematic` draw it.
props.name: title

props.description: A screenshot or a live widget.
props.name: children

props.description: Lets the frame run past its parent's edge, which clips it: `bottom`, `end` or both. Defaults to `none`.
props.name: bleed

props.description: A pill switcher docked on the frame's bottom edge, such as a SegmentedControl of surfaces.
props.name: tabs
